sunfields.name: Sunfields / The Reach
sunfields.text: A harsh itinerant frontier of routes and socially distinct communities, each with its own hierarchy, customs, grievances and relationship to outsiders. Objects called Sunforges appear as ruins, landmarks, civic fixtures, taboos, salvage or background facts depending on the community; no universal explanation is visually or culturally authoritative. Keep the weirdness human-scale and locally plausible: coincidence, expectation, coercion, eccentricity and bad luck can accumulate around Kael without visible 'probability' effects.
